description: Repo-local semantic acceptance corpus for the hyf_v1_jev refactor. Cases are synthetic intent projections, not recorded Jev judgments or an existing public wire protocol.

shared_wire_authority.note: The existing shared-wire declaration is preserved; this new semantic family is repo-local after adoption. No runtime parent-checkout dependency is created.

activation_policy: Each mandatory case activates at its required_from_step; planned cases are not counted as passing behavior.
